book.name: Mark
book.title: Yesu Keriso Tuyeghana Ahiꞌahina Mark Vivireina i Girugirumiya

content: Yesu i Riwa da Muriyai Maimaituwa ana Numa* hina Goruhi
Yesu maranai Maimaituwa ana Numa* i vomahiri aharei, ma a tauvotagho emosi i ripa, “Tauvihanahanapu, ma inanai! We ghaꞌimahi hi ahi ghagha ma ghaeghaehiyei we numahi waiguyaunana hi vowai.”
Ma Yesu i paribeei ipa, “U inanai we numahi ghaeghaehina! Apo egha ghaꞌima emosi ana au gabu ina maꞌae, atapuna apo rava hina goruhi.”
Piripiri Ghaeghaehi apo Rava hina Viꞌaroni, Tauvitumaghana hina Vojijina
Maranai Yesu i tughutughura Oya Olive autepana, Maimaituwa ana Numa* ma autupo ghehauna, ma Peter, James, John ma Andrew, hi vaini po auririva ma hi raubayadei hipa,
“Ma riweꞌai, meyanai we ginaurihi apo hina tupuwa, ma apo matakiraha aiwa a inanai da eighereghere po ina tupuwa?”
Ma Yesu i riwehi ipa, “Ona inana vaimaiha po egha aiya ina rautayahaboꞌami.
Rava magha apo wavaꞌuwei hina neꞌi ma hinapa, ‘Taꞌu yana tauna!’ Ma rava magha apo hina rautayahaboꞌahi.
Egha nuwanuwami ina araꞌarayaguri maranai ghaviya tuyeghana o nonori po aughereghere bo auheiya. We dewahi yana apo hina tupuwa, ma yamna egha mara damona ita gheꞌeta.

Dobu hina vitona vivira ma dam hina vitona vivira. Ma dobu ghehauhi apo yoyo ina ravihi ma wate gomara ina raꞌata. We dewahi yana me wavina duwaduwamana ana voavoa viuvana ei kare, ma muriyai apoꞌapoe dumana ina neꞌi.

Taumi ona paꞌinameemi, apo ami ghaviya hina panimi ma hina amverenemi ani viꞌemosi numana babadahi auwarihi. Ma hina kwapumi aniviꞌemosi au numahi, ma oi tumaghaneꞌu aubaina dobu babadahi aunaohi ona mahiri ma hina hetaremi anima tuyegha ahiꞌahina ona rauguguyei auwarihi.
Ma muriyai da damona ina neꞌi, yana aꞌu tauvotagho tuyeghaꞌu ahiꞌahina rava atapuhi auwarihi hina rauguguyei.

Ma maranai hina panimi yana rauhetara auwarina egha onai nuwaboya da apo me ona vibabaninei. Na au marana aiwa i raugheꞌetei yana ona yatoni, babana aiwa e yatoyatoniya yana Aruwa Vivireinei ma egha taumiei.
Rava varevarehihi hina amverenehi babada auwarihi po hina vihiraghenihi, ma ama apo natunatuhi auwarihi nanaꞌarena hina dewai, ma natunatu apo taughunihi hina vighaviyehi ma hina vihiraghenihi.
Ma o votaghoꞌu aubaina apo rava atapuhi hina geduꞌaiemi, ma rava aiya ina maꞌe momota po au damona yana apo ina yawahana.”
Piripiri Apoꞌapoe Dumana
Yesu i ripa, “Ginauri apoꞌapoe dumana apo ona inanai ina raugheꞌetei au dobu mepa egha ita rauinanaiyana.
(Tauhiyava we bukana o hiyahiyavi ona vinuwanuwatuhuwana vaimahiꞌeni.) Anima au Judea taumaꞌae yana hina virovoiyana au oya.
Rava aiya numa autepana egha ana hauga ina aharei, po ina hopu au numa ma ina rui po a nimapota aiwa ina vaini.
Rava aiya au ꞌwapu, yana egha ana hauga ina aharei po ina wanavirai a au numa, po anirauhawawara ina vaini.
No haugahi yana apo hina apoꞌapoe duma waivine duwaduwamahi, ma waighughuhi auwarihi!
Ona raupari po ami rovo egha hauga apoꞌapoe ina wawara na au marana!

Babana no haugahi yana apo hina apoꞌapoe duma, egha hauga ghehauna meyanai dobu we nanaꞌarena ita hanapuwei. Maranai au karena Maimaituwa dobu i viwawari ma i ne po we amadoꞌi. Wate apo eghaiwa ghehauna we nanaꞌarena ina tupuwame.
Ma Bada we marana piripirina ina raitupoi, ma itapa eꞌegha, apo egha aiya ita maꞌamaꞌae. Ma ana rava aubaihi we marana i raitupoi.
Anima na au marana aiya ina riwa inapa, ‘Ona inana, Keriso, Maimaituwa a Vinevine Waiyawahanana* wehidana!’ bo, ‘Ona inanai tauna nohidana!’ yana egha onai tumaghanei.

Babana keriso waimorumoruhi, ma peroveta waimorumoruhi apo hina vomahiri. Apo matakiraha po ani amhuna hina vogheꞌetehi, po Maimaituwa ana rava vinevinehi hina rautayahaboꞌahi yamna inapa emoꞌemosina.
Yamna aubaina ona inana vaimaiha! Muriyai po we dewahi hina tupuwa yana a ririwemi.”
Rava Natuna a Nememeei
Anima Yesu ipa, “Piripiri apoꞌapoe dumahi aumurina

content.text: ‘ginauri atapuhi kajikajijirahi au mara hina viguhuguhu.
Madegha apo ina waguvarei ma nawaravi egha ina raraname,

content: Na au marana rava atapuhi hina inaꞌinana, ma Taꞌu Rava Natuna au hapau kajijira ma borumana maitehi ana neꞌi.
Anima a aneya* ina himirihi dobu tupo wahepari po ana rava vinevinehi ina boinihimaꞌi dobu au mutuna po au mutuna.”
Eyagi Kaiyaha Ampariruvaruvana
“Vihanahanapu kaiyaha auwarina tana vaini. Maranai raghana e raunabinabi po ruguruguna e tereterei, yana ta hanapuwei da raupupu ana mara e tutugheregherei.
Nanaꞌarena ona inanai ma we ginaurihi hina tuputupuwa, yana ona haramanei da Taꞌu Rava Natuna aꞌu nememeei ana mara i vighereghere we au mataꞌeta.
Moina a ririwana dumemi, we hapana o mahimahiri apo yohora ona maꞌamaꞌae ma we dewahi ataphi apo hina wawara.
Mara ma dobu hina hamowa, ma ponaꞌu apo egha meyanai ina hamowa.”
Yesu a Wanavira Aubaina ta Vononogha
“Egha aiya ita hanapuwei da metauna maratomna, bo mara aiwa apo ina neꞌi, aneya* au mara ma Natuna egha hita haramanei, ma Amana tauꞌavana.
Onai raurauꞌona, ma onai mayavaivaina, babana egha ota haramanei mara aiwaꞌi apo na marana ina neꞌi.
Aniꞌinana me rava ana numa i neꞌaharei ma a hewahewari i autanihi, po yamoha a bagibagi ina dewadewai, ma mataꞌeta taupaꞌinina i riwei po inai raurauꞌona.
Yamna aubaina onai raurauꞌona babana egha ota hanapuwei da numa taniwagana mara aiwa ina wanavirai. Mepapo aubigai bo waguvara aupouna, bo kamkam ina toutou au maratomtom bo madegha e gheꞌegheꞌeta.
Ona vononogha inapa ina raighohoghorimi, yana egha ina nehaghami da taumi o enoꞌeno.
Aiwa a ririwemi yana rava atapuhi auwarihi nanaꞌarena, onai raurauꞌona.”

footnotes.text: Daniel 9:27; 2 Thessalonians 2:4; Au Matthew 24:15Yesu i riwa apo ona inana Maimaituwa a au Numa.
